meta.name: content-pillar-atomizer
meta.description: Take 1 blog post or article and generate 15-30 platform-native micro-content pieces. Not reformatting — re-contextualizing for each platform's culture. Triggers on: "atomize this content", "repurpose my blog post", "turn this into social posts", "content atomizer", "pillar content", "one to many content", "repurpose content", "multiply my content", "content explosion", "turn article into posts", "break down this article", "micro content from blog", "content pillar strategy", "10x my content", "platform-native content", "atomize", "content multiplication".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将一篇博客文章自动转化为多条适配各平台的微内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有博客文章需要快速生成社交帖子
copy.tagline_en: Turn one blog post into multiple platform-native micro-content pieces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a blog post and need to quickly generate social media posts

howto.what: Claude会将你提供的一篇长文章或博客帖子拆解成15-30条短内容，每条都针对特定平台（如Twitter、LinkedIn）的文化和格式重新创作，而不是简单复制粘贴。每条内容独立可发布。
howto.when: 当你要求“原子化这篇文章”、“把博客变成社交帖子”或直接粘贴一段长内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇博客拆成Twitter和LinkedIn帖子
say.note: Claude会生成对应平台的微内容

say.text: 用这篇文章生成15条社交媒体短内容
say.note: 默认分配平台，可指定数量

say.text: 把这个文章变成Reddit帖子，去掉广告味道
say.note: 会按Reddit社区规则调整语气

howto.what_en: Claude deconstructs a long article or blog post into 15-30 platform-native micro-content pieces, each re-contextualized for specific platforms (e.g., Twitter, LinkedIn) rather than reformatted. Each piece stands alone and is ready to publish.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'atomize this content', 'turn this into social posts', 'break down this article', or when you provide a long-form piece of content.

say_en.text: Break this blog into Twitter and LinkedIn posts
Turn this article into 15 social media pieces
Repurpose this article as Reddit posts without affiliate angle
say_en.note: Adapts to Reddit culture and tone
